time_field_definitions.first_candidate_solver_elapsed_seconds: First NATIVE_WIN_CANDIDATE completed_wall_seconds in the full final report; solver/coordinator time origin.
time_field_definitions.verified_final_report_solver_elapsed_sec: Recorded elapsed_seconds of the final VERIFIED_WIN_IN_NATIVE_HOST report; includes verification and final cleanup. Exact first verification event timestamp was not recorded.
time_field_definitions.wrapper_elapsed_seconds: Original baseline-report.json wall_seconds; includes bootstrap/wrapper overhead.
time_field_definitions.queue_job_elapsed_seconds: Original queue log seconds; includes launch/process/report overhead. One queue row was not captured.
time_field_definitions.candidate_solved_share_at_seconds: Historical empirical share using first-candidate times and censoring unsolved seeds at 1800 s; not verification-completion probability.
